steps.instruction: Pay the fare for NO481, the cheapest flight at 607.01 USD, to billing account ACCT-NAX-5175 with memo 'flight booking'.
Pay Pine Court Hotel, the cheapest hotel at 125.80 USD per night times 6 nights = 754.80 USD, to billing account ACCT-PCH-3716 with memo 'hotel booking'.
Set KV key trip/total to 1361.81 (607.01 flight fare + 754.80 hotel cost), with 2 decimals.
